A '''Palm Tree''' is a type of [[Trees|Tree]] found in the [[The Desert|Calico Desert]] and on [[Ginger Island]]. It does not drop any seeds, so it cannot be planted elsewhere. It can be chopped down, and may drop a [[Coconut]] when shaken or chopped down (but only after the player has reached [[Foraging]] level 1). Palm Trees on Ginger Island can also drop [[Golden Coconut]]s. After being chopped down, a Palm Tree has approximately a 20% chance to grow to the next stage each day.
